svg.title: Learning · CyberAlchemy Lab concept map
svg.desc: Record what happened, examine possible failure patterns and test uncertain explanations. Advice for later work needs recorded use and an assessment of its benefit. Select a node for its role, example and connections. Arrows are explanatory role connections.

g.title: An observation may support a record of a particular failure against a stated requirement.
Assessment preserves cause, impact, recovery and uncertainty separately.
The assessment checks whether evidence supports the reusable mode.
A declared scheme organizes values and assignments; it establishes no cause.
Uncertain mechanisms can motivate a research inquiry and testable hypothesis.
The design specifies conditions, comparison, measurement and acceptance criteria.
The run records one actual execution of the selected design.
Evaluation states what the selected run supports under the declared criteria.
A lesson records evidence, use conditions, exclusions, expected benefit and what would contradict the prediction.
The exact lesson revision’s use or deliberate non-use is recorded.
Compare the predicted benefit with evidence from this use, including results that would contradict it.
Research evidence can support, revise or reject advice under the examined conditions.
Outcome evidence can motivate an explicitly governed lesson successor or withdrawal.

text.tspan: What was used in later work
